notes.title: 1.401 "easy achievements" build
notes.notes:
I added a checkbox that instantly gives you all the achievements. This is mostly for people who want to get all the achievements and don't actually play the game. And the game is out for a while, so anyone who wanted to normally collect them was able to do so.

I also added a small Credits section where I thank some of my patreons. I think this is the last patch to Fap Queen 1, as I am already working on the second part and I'd really like to focus on that.

notes.title: 1.4 patch
notes.notes:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33633857/c61ccc01247e45ff8ded9b31b7f7c51031e6d932.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33633857/8deaf4710b119a612fad85f1cc38d741eea6d6ec.png[/img][/url]

Sorry for the long wait, this patch was kinda big.
- Yasmine, a new character, was added to the game
- Setup screen that lets you set up a time, ending, and punishment options (you can even completely switch it off)
- Many QoL changes (separate moan/laugh sound settings, typo fixes thanks to a certain helpful fan, and such)


This is the last big patch to Fap Queen 1, since I am already planning the second part. That'll have its own announcement, I am just hinting a bit :D

notes.title: Support dlc available!
notes.notes:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33633857/2e9f7baee90726ed0227007952cf889d1e5fdd48.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33633857/980944bd0a52289c35f11430d7a1b78a08c1f272.png[/img][/url]

Hey, there is a[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/977070/Fap_Queen_Support_DLC/?beta=0] DLC to Fap Queen [/url]to those few people who want to support me and help me recovering my costs :D It doesn't affect the game, it just adds a single picture at the start of the game with a thank you message. After that the game continues as normal.

Recovering the costs would be nice, but if it becomes a success, then Fap Queen 2 comes one step closer to happening. Thank you for considering supporting Fap Queen! :D

notes.title: New end scene
notes.notes:
Among a few other small fixes and changes, there is a new end scene for the best (queen) ending. No censorship in the game ofc.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33633857/9145eecbc3d2a7254223bae20653fc94bb1063f8.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33633857/6fe08c1bfc4eb254ef0079bacd84a0b56168d027.png[/img][/url]

The end scene was also a test for me, because if there will be ever a FQ2, that will have more of these and I really wanted to check how it goes. 

You can also change the speed in the game, as the mistress asks you a few times about it, you can skip the intro if you already know the drill, etc.

Anyway, as usual, have fun!

notes.title: Small bugfix
notes.notes:
The current update is just a small bugfix patch, nothing serious. (for example you can't ask for mercy during the introduction, messing up the scripting a bit)  
More content (graphical too) is coming in the future though :D Hard to say when, as getting new art is a time-consuming process.

notes.title: Achievements are in!
notes.notes:
Well, the title says it all :D
But there are also some other changes, to respond to some of the problems some reviews mention. 
- The game now explicitely warns you after your session time that you should push a certain button unless you want the game to go on forever 
- you can do a denial scenario (since it is No Nut November :D)
- some new lines added
- fullscreen mode is in (actually that was always in, but now it is on a button on the top right corner)
- an additional button that might be useful in some shameful cases :D

notes.title: Achievements
notes.notes:
I heard your wishes, and it seems these aren't hard to implement. You can't get them yet, but on testing it is already working.

I know that some people like to get 100% of the achievements, so I won't do heavily random based or just simply time-consuming ones (so no "60 minutes played", sorry!). There will be achievements for all endings (queen, succ, deny) and a few other stuff, but let me know in the comments if you have some other ideas.

Note: the achievement art on the picture is just placeholder, but it can't be too lewd anyways because Steam regulations.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33633857/32f75118e55cf4ad167e13f82022d8b5c1bf7eb3.png[/img]

notes.title: After Launch
notes.notes:
Some information you might find interesting:

- Almost 2000 downloads
- Median time played: 7 minutes :D (but I guess that includes those people who just started the game and decided its not for them).
- Some people (I don't know who, data is not personalized, just the numbers) had 30+ minutes of a play session, that's hardcore!
- Reviews are surprisingly positive and hilarious :D

notes.title: Released?
notes.notes:
Well at least I pushed the release button, so it should be online soon. [strike]There seems to be some kind of a problem and I am investingating it. Sorry!
[/strike] It seems it was fixed and you should be are able to download it. 

Anyway, I can't believe I made it to Steam, due to the, uh, spicy nature of the game. But here it is. If the game will be ever downloadable, please let me know if you encounter any problems, I am not very good at tech stuff (building steam versions of the game, setting it all up) so it is possible that there will be some problems. You can write an email too if you feel that is more private :) It is yaluar01 at gmail dot com, the same as the support email.

Be safe, have fun!

notes.notes: Fap Queen 1.2 (that includes the Succubus mistress!) will be released at Friday. I hope you will like it :D
